_what: Config for the heat rock — the always-on Windows box in the office that prints the Wednesday list. Site/list identity is read from ../print/render.config.json so there is exactly one place those live.
_queueNote: The print queue OWNS the job spec. Its printing defaults must be: 5 copies, collate, two-sided flip-on-long-edge, staple top-left, black & white, Letter. The script deliberately passes no print settings — one source of truth, and it's the driver's.
